arguments.query: SELECT id, status, flight_id, passenger_id, request_id, amount_cents FROM bookings ORDER BY id;
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" ORDER BY name;
SELECT booking_id, status, flight_id, passenger_id, amount_cents, request_id FROM bookings;
SELECT event_id, booking_id, payload, status, attempts FROM outbox;
SELECT charge_id, booking_id, amount_cents, state FROM charges;

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE h.booking_id IS NULL;
